rulesHonored: no merge or push while prod audit is non-zero

plan.name: Classify Prisma runtime reachability
plan.rationale: pnpm audit --prod reports Prisma CLI transitive chain because the lockfile walks the workspace. Customer-local setup needs `prisma migrate deploy` via `node node_modules/prisma/build/index.js`, so the `prisma` package must stay installed in customer-local deployments. Therefore remediation is NOT to move `prisma` to devDependencies; remediation is to upgrade Prisma to a release whose `@prisma/dev` pulls patched transitive deps.

plan.name: Remediate @hono/node-server + valibot via Prisma parent upgrade
plan.rationale: prisma@7.9.1 is the smallest compatible upgrade. Its pinned @prisma/dev=0.24.17 declares valibot@1.4.2 (>= patched) and no longer declares @hono/node-server as a dependency, so both Hono moderate advisories disappear from the prod graph.

plan.name: Remediate body-parser via precise pnpm override
plan.rationale: express@5.2.1 declares body-parser@^2.2.1. The resolved body-parser 2.2.2 lies within the range but is vulnerable; 2.3.0 is the smallest compatible patched release. A root override `body-parser: 2.3.0` is precise, compatible with Express 5.2.1, and forces the graph to the patched version.

plan.name: Diagnose brace-expansion lockfile anomaly and remediate
plan.rationale: The previous user-added root override `brace-expansion: 5.0.8` had been removed before this batch, which allowed the lockfile to downgrade brace-expansion to 1.1.16 / 2.1.2 to satisfy minimatch 3 and 5/9 caret ranges. The CVE-2026-14257 advisory covers both versions. minimatch 3/5/9 declare non-overlapping ranges for brace-expansion; pnpm cannot satisfy them simultaneously with the caret range. The only convergent patched target is brace-expansion@5.0.8 itself. Restoring the root override to `brace-expansion: 5.0.8` resolves all paths through minimatch to the patched version because brace-expansion@5.x keeps the public expand() API stable and only adds an optional maxLength knob. No minimatch upgrade was needed.

plan.name: Final security gate
plan.rationale: Run `pnpm install --lockfile-only` then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm audit --prod --json`, and confirm exit=0 with critical=0, high=0, moderate=0, low=0.
